Agent 20/35 — differential locking transient through apex-to-exit. Audit left/right wheel-speed delta, diff torque transfer and yaw as throttle is reapplied while steering unwinds. Check for abrupt locking that straightens the car or causes inside-wheel artifacts. Preserve AWD/RWD modes and canonical signs. Any fix must be physically motivated, symmetric and validated with power-on corner tests plus M5 strict validation.
